summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting a binding settlement term sheet resolving litigation between Workhorse Group Inc. and Coulomb Solutions, Inc. The settlement requires a $4.3 million payment, to be funded through existing credit facilities, with final dismissal subject to a definitive agreement by April 30, 2026, and payment by May 28, 2026. This is a legal settlement, not a special situation corporate event. No special-situation category applies; the filing is a routine current report on an other event item.
